Senator Nangle, Representative Crafts, and the esteemed members of the Joint Standing Committee on Transportation.

My name is Jim Libby, and I am the State Senator representing District # 22, comprised of the

towns of Naples, Sebago, Baldwin, and Standish in Cumberland County; Hiram and Porter in

Oxford County; and Limington, Limerick, Cornish, Parsonsfield, Newfield, Acton, and

It is my honor to bring to your attention the contents of L.D. 686, "Resolve, to Rename the Kezar
Falls Bridge Between Porter and Parsonsfield the Kezar Falls Veterans Memorial Bridge."

This bill seeks to honor those who have served in our armed forces by renaming the Kezar Falls
Bridge (Bridge 2432), the Kezar Falls Veterans Memorial Bridge

I am providing the letters of approval from the Towns of Porter and Parsonsfield for you today.
Both are in the same packet.
I hope you join me in recognizing the brave men and woman who fought to protect our country

Testimony of Meghan Russo Maine Department of Transportation
Before the 132"" Legislature, Joint Standing Committee on Transportation
Neither For Nor Against
LD 686, Resolve, to Rename the Kezar Falls Bridge Between Porter and Parsonsfield the
Kezar Falls Veterans Memorial Bridge
Senator Nangle, Representative Crafts and distinguished members of the Joint Standing
Committee on Transportation, I am Meghan Russo, Director of Government Affairs at
MaineDOT. MaineDOT is neither for nor against LD 686.
MaineDOT considers the naming of bridges, roadways, and other state transportation infrastmcture to be within the purview of the Legislature. Simply put, we build them and you name them. Accordingly, we generally do not take positions on so-called "naming bills." However, we usually submit written testimony regarding whether the particular infrastructure under consideration has been named before, and if so what those name(s) are. In this case, we are not aware of any previous legislatively-sanctioned names for this bridge. MaineDOT's
current inventory number for this structure is 2432.
Thank you.
